reviewer_type: developer/AI source-text review, not independent expert annotation
timing: After medical development outputs existed, before medical transfer inference; no prompts, inputs, labels or original records changed
coverage: Read source views, constructed original/paraphrase/error answers and remaining evidence for all 23 groups. This is not a certification that other labels are error-free.

issues.issue: Original and paraphrased first facts name Natsal-3. The supplied title names Natsal without the wave number and the selected two sentences do not establish Natsal-3. Counts are present, but the full named fact is not wholly established by this source view.
issues.original_label_status: The supported label needs a qualification; source-view support for the wave identifier is unresolved. This does not show the paper itself used a different wave.
issues.action: Retain frozen labels and primary results. Report a post-hoc sensitivity view omitting all four variants of this source group for every method. Do not silently fix labels or count sensitivity as a fresh confirmatory study.

general_limits: Changed exact numerical totals use ordinary exhaustive reporting semantics; not every numerical change is a formal logical contradiction.
Context-dependent second facts are scored within the original answer; standalone extraction can drop that context.
The synthetic controls do not measure clinical applicability, study quality or cross-paper comparability.
